objective: Unattended near-bottom dissolved oxygen, salinity/conductivity and temperature node using existing pier power and Wi-Fi, retrievable from deck for 7-14 day summer service.

preferred_bom.item: Atlas Bare-Bones Wi-Fi Hydroponics Kit BB-Wi-Fi-HK
preferred_bom.role: ESP32-S3, enclosure, three electrically isolated EZO slots, USB-C power

preferred_bom.item: Atlas Lab Grade Dissolved Oxygen Probe ENV-40-DOX
Atlas EZO Dissolved Oxygen Circuit EZO-DO
Atlas Mini Conductivity Probe K1.0 ENV-20-EC-K1.0
preferred_bom.role: conductivity input used to derive salinity

preferred_bom.item: Atlas EZO RTD Temperature Circuit EZO-RTD
Atlas Standard PT-1000 Temperature Probe PT-ST
Atlas Zero Dissolved Oxygen Calibration Set
preferred_bom.role: zero-DO calibration because sub-1 mg/L accuracy is important

preferred_bom.item: Atlas Dissolved Oxygen Anti-Fouling Probe Screen
preferred_bom.role: low-cost fouling reduction between 7-14 day service visits

remaining_budget_for: marine cable glands and strain relief
microSD or other local buffer if not already adequate
architecture_notes: The three isolated EZO slots are intended for DO, EC and RTD in this build; no pH channel is required for phase 1.
DO and conductivity must remain electrically isolated because conductivity excitation can interfere with electrochemical DO measurements.
The low-cost Atlas DO probe is galvanic, not optical; preserve that distinction in provenance and QC.
Secure Wi-Fi credentials in device/NVS storage, never repository files, and auto-reconnect after outages.
Buffer raw readings locally and backfill with original observed_at timestamps after Wi-Fi outages.
Mount the probes off a pier piling on a retrievable stand-off/cage, not flush to the piling, with an indexed repeatable height approximately 0.15-0.30 m above sediment.
Depth/pressure can be deferred in phase 1 if required to stay within budget; preserve fixed sensor elevation and pair with NOAA/local water-level context.
admission_guardrails: No production weight until QC/provenance pass and held-out incremental value is demonstrated.
Service/calibration windows are flagged and excluded from physical feature transitions.
No owner predawn manual sampling is assumed.
